policy_read_model_observation.retrieval_ctx: crates/kria-core/src/memory/retriever.rs:98 RetrievalCtx { namespaces, scopes, include_secret=false, token_budget=800 } — CALLER-SUPPLIED, not derived from an authenticated caller identity/owner. api.rs:487 search(query, ctx: Option<RetrievalCtx>) defaults ctx=None → include_secret=false + empty namespaces/scopes (no per-caller authorization).
policy_read_model_observation.critical_gap: There is NO Effective_Policy engine mediating reads. The only read-side gate is ScopeFilter, and it is (a) built from caller-supplied RetrievalCtx (never from identity/owner/scope of the requester), (b) applied ONLY on the retriever search path (vector + FTS), and (c) NOT applied at all on graph traversal, graph analytics, explain-by-id, aggregate health/metrics, change-stream, or export/backup. All live desktop/server search commands pass ctx=None (static default), so 'policy' is a constant, not MGR-004.2 most-restrictive Effective_Policy.

policy_application_position.notes: Only R-vector-search enforces full scope+sensitivity before rank truncation. R-retriever-search is mixed (vector pre-rank, FTS post-rank). R-fts-query ranks pre-policy. Graph reads (neighbors/relationships/search-entities/centrality/communities/predict), explain-by-id, aggregate health/metrics, change-stream, and export/backup apply NO policy on read.

policy_after_serialization_or_never_risk: R-graph-neighbors / R-graph-relationships / R-graph-search-entities — traversal + serialization with no policy filter.
R-graph-centrality / R-graph-communities / R-graph-predict-links — analytics computed + serialized over unauthorized graph.
R-explain-memory / R-ui-memory-inspector — by-id read returns any record incl. Secret.
R-aggregate-health-metrics — global counts include hidden records (MGR-004.5).
R-export-backup — full raw authority dump incl. Secret.
policy_after_rank_before_serialize: R-fts-query — bm25 rank + top-k LIMIT precede scope/sensitivity; retriever drops rows only post-fusion (candidate count/rank see pre-policy rows).
cache_keys_missing_policy_identity_revis: No application-level RESULT cache exists on any read path (analytics recomputed each call → MGR-009.4 revision-keyed cache UNIMPLEMENTED).
AnnVectorStore in-RAM HNSW partition = index cache, not result cache; filters at query time (no leak).
RetrievalWeightStore adaptive RRF weights are global per query-class, NOT keyed by policy/identity/revision (weights influence ranking across all callers).
SQLite read-pool page cache is rebuilt on restore (H3); not a policy-keyed result cache.
UI graphData reactive signals + loadGeneration guard are not policy/identity/revision keyed (no server revision exists to key on).
client_side_filtering_leaks: R-ui-graph-read-layer assumes memory_graph_* payloads are server-policy-filtered — they are not; protected entities/edges/display_names render.
R-ui-graph-read-layer 'showing N of M' uses a backend-pre-limited count as M → misrepresents corpus total.
R-ui-memory-inspector discloses full record via memory_explain trusting an unauthorized backend by-id read.
R-desktop-search-commands apply `limit` client-side via .take() and report count=displayed slice (no true total).
analytics_vocabulary_issues: MGR-011.1 VIOLATION: connected-components (union-find) is named 'community'/'communities' in graph_intel.rs:166, desktop command memory_graph_communities, contract JSON key 'communities', and UI (buildCommunityIndex/categoryForNode/community color). Must be `component` end-to-end.
MGR-011.2/.3: centrality and community outputs carry NO algorithm name/version/params/graph-predicate/Graph_Revision/quality metadata in their payloads.
MGR-011.4: reasoning 'hallucination_rate', plan 'success_rate', prediction 'score' presented without grounded interpretation labels.
serialization_boundary_gaps: All Tauri/Axum read DTOs are ad-hoc serde_json::json! shapes (contract.rs / memory.rs), NOT versioned contracts.
MGR-006.2 missing on hit_json: result kind, matched field, rank rationale, policy summary, Truth_State, Graph_Revision, navigation target.
MGR-007.1/.2 missing on graph DTOs: schema version, Graph_Revision, query hash, policy-safe scope, filters, window metadata, total semantics, truncation, recovery cursor.
No Graph_Revision concept exists anywhere (confirmed by grep) — blocks MGR-007.2/.3 cursor snapshots and MGR-008 patch consistency.

unknowns_needing_resolution.question: There is no identity/owner-derived Effective_Policy on reads (ScopeFilter is caller-supplied and all live commands pass ctx=None). Confirm the intended source of caller identity/owner/scope for read authorization (MGR-004.1/.2) and where Effective_Policy is computed before planning.

Confirm whether research().timeline and goals().active_goals apply any state/scope filtering (they appear to return active rows without policy). Verify exact SELECT predicates in F0.3.3 schema inventory.

Confirm no Retrieval_Trace is persisted anywhere (no trace table found). MGR-025 requires persisted/returned policy-safe trace with fusion contributions, gating, token allocation, model versions, context-injected ids.

key_findings: NO Effective_Policy on reads (MGR-004.4 core violation): the only read-side gate is a caller-supplied ScopeFilter, applied on just the retriever search path. All live desktop/server search commands call search(query, None) → static default (include_secret=false, no namespace/scope restriction), never an identity/owner-derived Effective_Policy computed before planning/count/rank/serialize/cache/render.

GRAPH reads have ZERO policy: neighbors, relationships_for, search_entities, degree_centrality, communities, predict_links all read entities/relationships with no scope/sensitivity/namespace filter and truncate (LIMIT / max_hops) before any policy — full graph, analytics, and predicted links leak protected topology, endpoints, and display_names (MGR-004.4/MGR-007.5).

FTS ranks pre-policy (MGR-004.4): SqliteSearchStore.query filters namespace only when exactly one namespace is supplied and applies NO scope/sensitivity filter; bm25 ranking + top-k LIMIT run over unauthorized rows, which the retriever drops only post-fusion — authorized rows can be truncated out and the candidate COUNT reflects pre-policy rows. Vector path (AnnVectorStore) is the one path that filters scope/sensitivity before rank truncation.

ANALYTICS VOCABULARY (MGR-011.1): connected-components (union-find) is mislabeled 'community/communities' in core (graph_intel.rs:166), the desktop command, the contract JSON, and the UI color/category model. No analytics output carries algorithm/version/params/predicate/Graph_Revision/quality metadata (MGR-011.2/.3).

explain-by-id and MemoryInspector leak (MGR-004): MemorySystem::explain returns any memory by id — full content, provenance, worth, access history — with no policy check; the UI inspector discloses every field trusting this.
AGGREGATES leak hidden records (MGR-004.5): health/metrics/report/timeline/goals counts are global COUNT/AVG over the whole bank with no caller-authorized count/label projection.

CHANGE-STREAM leaks + no revision (MGR-004 + MGR-008): notify_change broadcasts detail payloads (entity ids, source/target ids, display_names, counts) to all subscribers with no policy filter and no auth (server SSE), and carries NO Graph_Revision — no revision concept exists anywhere, blocking MGR-008 patch consistency (clients blindly re-fetch).

EXPORT is a raw full dump (MGR-004.7): the only live export read is backup_to (VACUUM INTO) — a byte-for-byte authority copy including Secret rows and all scopes, with no redaction. The policy-safe interchange/visual export contract (0x4D475208/209) exists only in kria-eval fixtures, not wired to any live exporter.

NO revision-keyed analytics cache (MGR-009.4 unimplemented): there is no application-level result cache on any read path; analytics recompute each call. Consequently there are no result-cache keys to leak, but also no MGR-009.4 revision-keyed caching, and the adaptive RRF weights that influence ranking are global (not policy/identity keyed).

SERIALIZATION DTOs are unversioned (MGR-006.2/MGR-007.1-.2): all Tauri/Axum read responses are ad-hoc serde_json shapes lacking result kind, matched field, rank rationale, policy summary, Truth_State, Graph_Revision, query hash, window/total/truncation metadata, and cursor.

CLIENT-SIDE honesty gaps (MGR-006.3): desktop search applies `limit` via .take() and reports count=displayed slice; the UI graph 'showing N of M' derives M from a backend-pre-limited centrality count — neither reflects the true corpus total.
coverage_note: Traced every required read category from live composition roots: memory reads (retriever search/recall/reason, explain-by-id, aggregate health/metrics), graph reads/traversal (neighbors, relationships, entity search), search (FTS SqliteSearchStore + ANN AnnVectorStore + hybrid Retriever, with the dormant SqliteVectorStore recorded Unavailable), analytics (degree centrality, connected-components-as-community, Adamic-Adar prediction), retrieval traces (ephemeral RetrievalTrace — MGR-025 Planned), export reads (raw backup live; interchange Planned), desktop query commands (commands/memory.rs), server query routes (memory_routes.rs GET + permissive CORS/no-auth), and the UI graph/memory read layer (graphData.ts/graphModel.ts/MemoryUniverse/MemoryInspector). Each record carries classification, evidence locator, policy-position, cache-key, serialization-boundary, and client-side-assumption facts. Unresolved facts (Effective_Policy source, timeline/goals predicates, trace persistence) recorded Unknown for F1/F0.3.3/F0.5.3.
